cues: A sharp ceremonial call announces an arrival, carrying clearly across a crowded civic square.
In a small jazz combo, a nimble lead line weaves above piano chords and brushed drums.
Bright upper-register notes lend a royal procession a sense of pageantry and public importance.
A muted phrase softens the melody, adding an intimate color to a late-night club arrangement.
At a ballpark, a brief musical flourish rallies spectators before the next inning begins.
A soloist shapes a rising fanfare, its clear attacks helping the melody stand above the ensemble.
